title: Stop --ship discarding live shared-doc edits in the supervising checkout
_pr_pinning: the PR number pinned by --pr lives in the gitignored sidecar tasks/<id>/.pr-number (not in this file); --ship reads it for forge-proof merge verification. Sidecar absence is valid (legacy/pre-PR state).

escalations.reason: Spec review hit 3 changes_requested iterations in a row (limit: 3). Pipeline auto-blocked. A repeated pushback usually means the spec has a structural or scope issue that another mechanical revision won't fix — read the latest spec-review.md and decide whether to revise scope, split the task, or defer. To resume after fixing: set phases.spec_review.status = "pending" and phases.spec_review.iterations_current_loop = 0 in status.json, then re-run the pipeline.

Code review surfaced a spec_gap verdict for task(s): ship-shared-doc-dirt-preservation. The implementation cannot resolve this — the root cause is in the spec. Recovery options (both operate on the full blocked bundle [ship-shared-doc-dirt-preservation]):
  FIX: amend spec.md with ## Amendment, then: canon run ship-shared-doc-dirt-preservation --reroute
  BLESS: canon task accept ship-shared-doc-dirt-preservation code_review --reason "<why>"

_verdict_values: approved | approved_with_nits | changes_requested | needs_re_review (legacy alias, routed/counted as changes_requested) | spec_gap | sanctioned (operator-only via canon task accept)
_full_send: true → skip spec gate + auto-open draft PR after clean QA. See docs/pipeline-orchestrator.md (`--full-send`).
